title: HtmlAddress
responsibility: Renders the native address element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlAddress.attributes
inputs.description: Native address attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlAddress.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native address element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlAddress
outputs.description: The actual native address element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
